scripts.dev:db: node scripts/validate-compose-environment.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait app-db tenant-db
scripts.dev:full: node scripts/validate-compose-environment.mjs && docker compose --profile full up -d --build --wait
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: pnpm dev:db && pnpm --filter @knowledgestack/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:studio: pnpm dev:db && pnpm --filter @knowledgestack/api exec prisma studio
